solves.reason: (A) enduring fits 'power of creativity' positive context; (B) connecting fits 'us with thoughts and emotions'; (C) deeper fits 'understanding'. ③ is the only all-positive combination.

(A) transcends fits 'time and space' — literature goes beyond limits; (B) retained fits 'relevance' — despite new tech, literature kept relevance; (C) unique fits 'ability' — authors have a special ability.
(A) relevance fits — literature kept its relevance; (B) capture fits — ability to capture complexities; (C) empathize fits — empathize with characters. ④ has all correct words.
③ restricts contradicts context. Literature 'transcends' (goes beyond) time and space, not 'restricts' (limits) it. Other markers are contextually appropriate.
② ordinary contradicts context. Authors have a 'unique' (special) ability, not 'ordinary' (common). Other markers are contextually appropriate.

'creativity and __________' — expression completes the pair naturally. The passage is about human creativity and expression as literature's essence.
'relevance and __________' — significance pairs with relevance in describing what literature has retained as a timeless art form.
'the __________ of relationships' — nuances (subtle differences) fits the pattern: depths of emotion, nuances of relationships, challenges and triumphs of spirit.
enduring = lasting (both mean continuing for a long time). fading, temporary, brief are all antonyms.
transcends = surpasses (both mean to go beyond or exceed). limits and restricts are antonyms, follows is unrelated.
convey = communicate (both mean to transmit/express information). conceal (hide), distort (twist), ignore are opposite or unrelated.
timeless (not affected by time) ↔ outdated (no longer current). eternal, classic, permanent are synonyms of timeless.
complexities (state of being complex) ↔ simplicities (state of being simple). intricacies, difficulties, subtleties are near-synonyms.
(A) human spirit = 정신 (mental/emotional force); (B) spirit of the law = 취지 (purpose/intent). Therefore (A)정신 — (B)취지.
'ability to understand and share feelings of another' defines empathy. Sympathy is compassion without sharing; creativity and expression are unrelated.
the __ (endure) power — adjective position between article and noun. endure → enduring (present participle as adjective).
a deeper __ (understand) of — noun position after adjective. understand → understanding (noun form).
'people from __________' — 'all walks of life' means people of all backgrounds, which connects to 'across centuries and cultures'.
'understanding of __________' — 'the human condition' is the ultimate theme of the passage about literature's power to illuminate human experience.
